summary: 硬岩矿供给比较必须区分矿石品位、精矿回收率、剥采比和矿山寿命阶段，同样精矿吨数背后的成本和可持续性差异很大。
why_search_may_miss_it: 市场供给表常只列精矿产量和现金成本，技术参数藏在矿山报告。

recalled_details.gap_reason: first pass focused projects and pricing; mine-plan quality variables were not formalized

suggested_queries: spodumene mine strip ratio recovery head grade lithium
锂矿 剥采比 品位 回收率 成本
disconfirmation_queries: spodumene mine costs independent of grade recovery strip ratio

summary: 硬岩矿项目高景气期的资本开支不仅受设备/工程价格影响，也受地下矿、露天矿、选厂和尾矿设施范围变化影响，capex revision本身是周期信号。
why_search_may_miss_it: 最终投产新闻会覆盖早期可研和多轮资本成本修订。

recalled_details.gap_reason: project delays were well covered, but capex revision as a separate expectation/outcome variable was not

suggested_queries: lithium project capex increase feasibility study revision 2022 2023
锂矿 项目 资本开支 上调 可研 修订
disconfirmation_queries: lithium project capex remained stable through 2021 2023 inflation

summary: 矿山股权、包销权和经营权在并购/重组中可能分开变化，同一资产‘谁拥有’与‘谁拿到精矿’不是同一问题。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公司并购新闻通常只写股权比例，包销/营销权藏在合资协议。

recalled_details.gap_reason: ownership changes were recalled, but ownership-vs-offtake-vs-operator roles were not separated
recalled_details.schema_implication: asset relationship edges need role and validity time

suggested_queries: lithium mine equity offtake operator rights joint venture
锂矿 股权 包销权 运营权 合资
disconfirmation_queries: mine equity ownership always equals proportional merchant concentrate access

summary: 新矿首次出矿、选厂首批精矿、首次装船和达到设计回收率是不同里程碑，市场常把first production过早当作稳定供给。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公司宣传喜欢first production，后续爬坡曲线需要跨季度追踪。

recalled_details.gap_reason: project lifecycle existed, but mine-specific production milestone ontology was not explicit

suggested_queries: lithium mine first ore first concentrate first shipment commercial production
锂矿 首矿 首批精矿 首船 商业生产
disconfirmation_queries: first concentrate equals stable commercial nameplate output

summary: 偏远锂矿项目的公路、港口、电力、水和营地基础设施可能决定投产节奏，资源量充足并不代表物流链可立即支持设计产量。
why_search_may_miss_it: 资源新闻聚焦矿体和选厂，公辅工程在项目可研/当地政府资料里。

recalled_details.gap_reason: project delays were recalled case-by-case but infrastructure dependency was not a reusable mechanism

suggested_queries: lithium mine road port power infrastructure delay Africa Australia
锂矿 项目 公路 港口 电力 供水 延期
disconfirmation_queries: remote lithium project ramp independent of infrastructure readiness

summary: 2021-2022长期短缺叙事中，市场常把大量绿地项目按计划纳入2024-2026供给，但许可、融资和爬坡折扣可能系统性被低估。
why_search_may_miss_it: 后来的实际投产结果会覆盖当时供给模型里每个项目原计划。

recalled_details.gap_reason: individual failed projects were covered, but the systematic project-risk assumption inside historical supply forecasts was not

suggested_queries: 2022 lithium supply forecast 2025 project pipeline delays
2022 锂供给 预测 项目 投产 2025 短缺
disconfirmation_queries: 2021 2022 lithium supply forecasts fully discounted project delay risk

summary: 矿山可能在价格弱或港口/客户受限时积累精矿stockpile，矿山生产量与销售/装船量可显著背离。
why_search_may_miss_it: 供给表常采用生产量，实际进入中国转换端取决于销售和装船。

recalled_details.gap_reason: concentrate inventory locations were modeled downstream, but mine production-vs-sales stockpile was not explicit

suggested_queries: lithium spodumene production sales stockpile quarterly
锂精矿 产量 销量 库存 矿山
disconfirmation_queries: spodumene mine production always equals shipments

summary: 一些项目在资源量和可研层面存在多年，但始终未做最终投资决定（FID）或反复推迟FID；供给模型应把pre-FID与under-construction严格分开。
why_search_may_miss_it: 项目新闻长期重复资源量/可研进展，容易被统计成‘在建/规划产能’。

recalled_details.gap_reason: failed projects were collected, but investment-decision maturity was not a standardized state

suggested_queries: lithium project FID delayed DFS permitted not sanctioned
锂矿 项目 FID 可研 未决策 投产预测
disconfirmation_queries: all DFS/permitted lithium projects proceed promptly to construction
